A FEW USEFUL DETAILS

Good to know.

Is this a monthly subscription?

No. The proposed offer is a one-time purchase of the downloadable version. Future major products and services are separate; ongoing hosted service and lifetime updates are not promised.

Where are my customers’ details stored?

In the browser you use, on your device. Records do not sync between devices. Export backups regularly; clearing browser storage can remove saved work. The app does not send quote records to a cloud account.

Does it tell me what cleaners in my area charge?

No. You choose the hours, pay, supplies, fees, and margin. Results are estimates based on those inputs. Confirm the scope and any applicable taxes yourself before sending a quote.

Does it send messages or collect customer payments?

It prepares documents and message copy. You save the PDF and send it yourself. Scheduling, automatic texting, customer payments, and accounting are outside this toolkit.

Can I use it on my phone?

The web demo has a responsive layout. The downloadable version is intended for a modern desktop browser; opening a downloaded HTML app and saving PDFs varies on phones. Try the demo on your device before buying.
